senses.gloss: (√גד, v. נגד a. גדל), Hif. הֵגִיד to stretch, prolong, postpone.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 21b:6">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 87a">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> (Ar. s. v. <cite ref="C00151"><he>גד</he></cite>, v. however <cite ref="A00239"><he>אָגַד</he> I</cite>) <he>שמֵגִידוֹת וכ׳</he> who postpone (reserve) sexual intimacy for their husbands.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:4:2">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אני מֵיגֶדֶת וכ׳</he> I will extend (spend all the time of) my widowhood in my husband’s house.
